title: Conversion to a sign tester
statement: Given an $E3$-linear sign tester with finite seed set, seed distribution, a sign right-hand side for each seed, and three queries for each seed, define a sign tester with the same seed set and distribution. Its check at a seed uses the predicate determined by that seed's right-hand side and the same three queries.
